data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name 'Laurus', meaning 'laurel'. The name 'Lyn' is derived from the Welsh word 'lyn', meaning 'pool'. In Christian tradition, laurel is symbolic of victory, and a pool can represent renewal or rebirth. The name Loralyn carries the meaning “Laurel + Lyn” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Loralyn usually hope their child will grow to embody laurel + lyn and live with faith, good character and purpose.
